prompt:
Subject: autobahn, target meaning "アウトバーン".

Composition: Show a compact elevated three-quarter view of a divided motorway segment, two lanes in each direction separated by a central barrier, clear white dashed lane markings and guardrails. Two small cars traveling consistently in one direction on one carriageway and one car traveling the opposite direction on the other. Whole isolated road segment with margins, no text signs or numbers.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown outlines, rounded simplified forms, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: Make a single compact composition with the main subject filling about 80-90% of the square. Keep the subject large, close, and fully inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, transparent background. No text, letters, labels, speech bubbles, borders, logos, or watermark.
EDIT: Correct only the direction of the white car on the right-hand carriageway. Turn that white car around 180 degrees so it travels toward the UPPER RIGHT, away from the viewer, opposite to the red and blue cars. Show the REAR of the white car at its lower-left end, with two small red taillights and a rear window; its front points upper-right. Keep the road, barriers, red and blue cars, colors, style, framing and transparency unchanged. No text.
en: Cars travel in opposite directions on an autobahn separated by a central barrier.
ja: アウトバーンでは、中央分離帯で分けられた上下線を車が反対方向に走っています。
